d:
The Kings defeated the Celtics, 97-96 tonight in Sacramento. Darius Acuff Jr. finished with a team-high 21 points along with 8 assists and 6 rebounds for the Kings, while De'Andre Hunter tallied 20 points, 6 rebounds and 2 assists in the game. Mike Conley recorded 19 points, 4 rebounds and 4 three pointers. The Kings improve their record to 2-14 with the win, while the Celtics fall to 11-5 for the season.
